description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-grimm-openapi-extension.
        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the OpenAPI extension; Maven resolves the transitive
        APT dependencies below automatically.
        Runs Grimm's processor on the application's classes: each JAX-RS resource gets
        a $$GrimmModel contribution holding its part of the OpenAPI document, so the
        runtime builds the document without scanning the resources and their schemas
        by reflection (vidocq-workspace#38).
